chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) forbade eating what the ant carries with its mouth and its legs.
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad forbid regarding food carried by ants?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes a specific dietary prohibition (nahy) regarding food carried by ants, reflecting the Shia emphasis on minute details of ritual purity (taharah) and hygiene in consumption. Scholars interpret this as a safeguard against impurities or foreign matter adhering to the food, illustrating the Prophetic tradition of extending cleanliness standards to even the smallest creatures. It underscores the principle that what is carried by an ant is considered distinct from the main food source, warranting exclusion to ensure the meal's purity.
